name: Natsumelo
source:
On the first of July, the main character moves to his aunt's house since his parents go abroad on business. His aunt welcomes him, but...

"I don't want to live with you," Kikka, his cousin, says coldly. On the next day, he accidentally sees Kikka changing clothes, and their relationship gets worse... 

His new life starts like this, and it gets more exciting, involving his sister and classmates...

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
7月1日，主人公因父母出国公干而搬到了姑妈家。姑妈热情地欢迎了他，但是……

"我不想跟你住在一起。"橘花——他的表妹冷冷地说道。第二天，他不小心撞见了橘花换衣服的场面，两人的关系变得更加紧张……

他的新生活就这样开始了，随着妹妹和同学们的加入，事情变得越来越热闹……
